title: Platyon of Rome
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A homily of his appears in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:5; Midrash Tehillim 28:2 reads Platon of Rome.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Platyon and Platon preserve the supplied name variation; conventional vowels, including the historical Pelatyon possibility, are not an adjudicated vocalization or identity with classical Plato. No personal title is supplied.

שהש״ר פ״ח-ה and מד׳ תהלים כח-ב are read as Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:5 and Midrash Tehillim 28:2. The latter’s Platon reading is Hyman’s report, without fresh collation or a verified modern numbering correspondence.
